next.reason: 1985: "begins at the leftmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1, regardless of its class, and proceeds from left to right"; 2023: "unless BACKWARD is specified, in which case, inspection ... begins at the rightmost character position ... and proceeds from right to left". Left-to-right inspection is kept, but 2023 adds a BACKWARD case that scans right to left. 1985 programs behave the same; the rule gains a case.
